olympiacos-comeback-370.title: 1–4 down at home. Then 6–1 in front of 370 people. Olympiacos 2024 #Shorts
olympiacos-comeback-370.desc:
March 2024. Olympiacos lost 1–4 at home to Maccabi Tel Aviv. The second leg was played in Bačka Topola, Serbia, in front of 370 people — and Olympiacos won 6–1 after extra time. Twelve weeks later they won the Europa Conference League.

olympiacos-tzolakis-istanbul.title: Three penalties. Three saves. Tzolakis in Istanbul #Shorts
olympiacos-tzolakis-istanbul.desc:
April 2024, Şükrü Saracoğlu, 44,040 people. Fenerbahçe v Olympiacos went to penalties, and Konstantinos Tzolakis saved three of them — Tadić, Cengiz Ünder and Bonucci. Olympiacos were in a European semi-final for the first time in their history.

olympiacos-final-116.title: The 116th minute that gave Greece its first European trophy #Shorts
olympiacos-final-116.desc:
29 May 2024, Athens. Olympiacos v Fiorentina, Europa Conference League final. Nil-nil after ninety minutes, then Ayoub El Kaabi's header in the 116th minute — and a long VAR check. The first European trophy ever won by a Greek club.
